name: 2025 World Championships Deck: JP Raging Bolt

releases.name: 2025 World Championships Deck: JP Raging Bolt

description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2025 World Championships, built around both versions of Raging Bolt. On the first turn Fan Rotom finds Pokémon for the Bench and Squawkabilly ex draws a new hand, Teal Mask Ogerpon ex adds Energy and Noctowl finds the Trainer cards that bring more, and Raging Bolt's Thunderburst Storm and Raging Bolt ex's Bellowing Thunder turn that Energy into damage. The 2025 World Championships were held from 15 to 17 August 2025 at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California, which had also hosted them in 2017.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2025 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
